sections.heading: Planning your Hougang Central mixed-use development interior
sections.text:
Until official documents exist, this page stays general. For a future shop, supermarket or F&B unit, the useful conversation with Maison is a fit-out: shopfront joinery, a counter, display and storage, and a back-of-house run, designed from a tenancy plan and a permitted trade, not from a news figure. Food trades will need a different services brief. For a future home, the usual first fit-out is built-in kitchen, wardrobe and living-room carpentry, designed from an approved residential plan. In both cases Maison specifies built-in carpentry, not IKEA-style loose furniture. No official floor plan is on file, and we will not invent a typologies mix for either component.

Tanjong Tree Residences @ Hougang and Kovan Wellspring, packed earlier, are nearby HDB pages and are not typologies references for this mixed-use site. We will not invent walking times to Hougang Central or to any MRT station, and we will not brief a contractor against a guessed 2027 launch or a guessed shop size.

If you later have a tenancy plan or a residential plan, WhatsApp Maison and we will work from those documents. After handover, the usual order is defects, landlord or HDB or management approvals as they apply to your unit, then fabrication. A modest non-food shop or a moderate home carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after approvals — an editorial allowance only. We are not affiliated with the parties named in the file.
